column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Kederon / Piripo's reconciliation with his parents
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: W-why...?!
Why have you appeared with people like these now, and why are you too trying to thwart my plans...?!
Th-that's not it, Father...
I only...
wanted you to see that this body you hated is healthy now...
I wanted Father and Mother... I wanted you to see me, just once...
D-don't be absurd, $$ピリポ$$!!
Word has reached me that you escaped from the $$ゴルゴダ$$ prison with its prisoners...
and have been cowardly running about ever since!!
And besides, to have become something so pitiful...
as a $$奴隷$$...
You...
Please stop this!!
M-Mother...
Ever since $$パルタ$$ left this village, you have talked of $$ピリポ$$ at every opportunity...
Surely you too...
were worried about $$ピリポ$$, were you not?
W-who would do something so wicked?!
Even the reason you deliberately built this village in such a place...
was originally to make a village where $$弱者$$ could live more easily, was it not?!
Th-then why...?
Why did Father listen to a mere $$医者$$ like that...?!
It is plain to see that the village will decline as the number of young people and children falls...
Ever since $$マモン$$ became this region's new $$強欲$$ $$領主$$...
we have been made to pay $$年貢$$ hundreds of times greater than before.
And ever since your brother $$パルタ$$ disappeared...
this man has done nothing but worry about you...
He sent you away so the villagers would not charge you with the $$罪$$ of being $$弱者$$...
and has prayed for the day he could bring you home again as soon as possible...
Your father tried to change this village into a place where $$弱者$$ could live more easily...
Enough!! You be quiet!
In any event, while the number of children continues to fall this much...
we cannot concern ourselves only with the elderly.
B-but!
They helped build this town; they have earned our gratitude...
Wait.
Every plant and animal that exists in $$この世$$ is made to put leaving as many descendants as possible...
above all else!
Yet in this village, are you not neglecting far too much the children who must build the world to come...?
Do you not think you neglect increasing their number far too much...?!
Even if you change future village policy to make it easier to bear children...
if the elders believe that their own descendants will increase, they will hardly oppose it outright...
The clearest proof is that you yourself, despite all you say...
are worried about your own children!!
Is that really so?!
Those old black-$$羽$$ men think of nothing but their own convenience...
Then you should cast such people aside!
After all, people in the streets...
call you a champion of $$正義$$, or so I hear...!
Come on. Now that you understand how Father feels, come home...
Even about those white $$羽$$...
Father would do anything to protect you...
Father... Mother...
This journey, for me...
feels as though it is also a journey to find myself...
But when this journey is over... I...
I will absolutely return to this village!!
